q1.text: What would you like to improve first?
q1.help: Pick what matters most to you right now. We’ll sort out the details later.

color_tipo.text: How would you describe the color of your teeth?

options.oscuro: One tooth darker than the others

color_meta.text: What kind of result are you hoping for?

options.natural: A lighter shade that still looks natural
options.luminosa: A whiter, more even, brighter smile
options.manchas: Fixing stains or uneven color between teeth

color_forma.text: Would you also like to change the shape or size?

esp_zona.text: Where are the gaps in your smile?

options.centrales: Between the two upper front teeth
options.ambas: In both arches, upper and lower
options.falta: I have a gap because one or more teeth are missing

options.visibles: Visible when I talk or smile

forma_tipo.text: What would you like to correct about the shape of your teeth?

options.cortos: My teeth look short or worn
options.largos: Some teeth are longer than others
options.simetria: I want a more symmetrical, harmonious smile

pos_grado.text: How would you describe the position of your teeth?

options.girados: Some teeth are rotated or stick out
options.mordida: I feel my bite doesn’t fit correctly

options.sin_brackets: A visually straighter smile without braces
options.mejorar: Improve the alignment and look of my teeth
options.alineadores: Correct the position of my teeth with aligners
options.evalue: I’d like the dental team to recommend the best option

options.pocos: One or two broken or heavily restored teeth
options.general: Wear on almost all of my teeth

desg_preocupa.text: What worries you most about your worn or fractured teeth?

options.forma: Restoring their original shape and size
options.resistencia: Restoring the strength of my teeth
options.evitar: Keeping them from wearing down or chipping further
options.completa: I need a complete cosmetic and functional makeover

desg_sintomas.text: Do you have any of these symptoms?
desg_sintomas.help: Choose the one closest to your case.

falt_cuantos.text: How many natural teeth are you missing?

options.todos: All teeth in one or both arches

falt_actual.text: Are you using anything to replace those teeth right now?

options.implantes: Yes, one or more dental implants
options.combinacion: A combination of implants and dentures

falt_reemplazados.text: How many teeth have been replaced with dentures or implants?

falt_zona.text: Where are the missing or replaced teeth?

falt_pref.text: What kind of solution would you prefer?

options.fija: Something fixed that I never have to take out
options.reemplazar: Swap my current denture for something more comfortable
options.rehab_fija: Get all my teeth back with a fixed solution
options.recomendacion: I’d rather get a professional recommendation

varias_enfoque.text: What are you mainly looking for?

cantidad.text: How many teeth visible when you smile would you like to improve?

prioridad.text: What matters most to you in your smile makeover?
prioridad.help: This helps us understand what you want. Your dentist confirms the right treatment at your exam.

options.natural: A natural, aesthetic and harmonious result
options.una_cita: Getting it done in a single visit
options.conservar: Keeping as much of my natural teeth as possible
options.doctora: I’d like the dental team to recommend the best option

viaje.text: When would you like to travel to Cancun?
viaje.help: So we can have your evaluation ready in time.

agenda.text: Would you like to book a personalized evaluation?

options.dudas: Yes, but I have some questions first

directas.name: Smile design with direct veneers
directas.desc: Change the color, shape and balance of your smile with a conservative technique that, for the right candidates, takes just one visit.

ceramicas.name: Smile design with ceramic veneers
ceramicas.desc: A premium option that’s strong, stain-resistant and designed to look natural and personal.

alineadores.name: Clear aligners
alineadores.desc: Gradually improve the position of your teeth with a personalized orthodontic treatment.

rehabilitacion.name: Custom dental restoration
rehabilitacion.desc: Bring back the shape, strength and function of your teeth with restorations made for you.

implantes.name: Dental implants and restorations
implantes.desc: Replace missing teeth with fixed or removable options, depending on your oral health.

protesis.name: Custom dentures
protesis.desc: Get your smile back and eat comfortably with a denture made for you, based on your clinical condition.

allon4.name: Full-mouth restoration
allon4.desc: Explore full dentures and fixed implant solutions, including All-on-4 and All-on-6 when they’re right for you.

valoracion.name: Comprehensive cosmetic and restorative evaluation
valoracion.desc: We’ll put together a personalized plan to restore the look, function and balance of your smile.

blanqueamiento.name: Teeth whitening
blanqueamiento.desc: Brightens your natural tooth color when it’s a good fit. It doesn’t change shape, size or position.

cta: Your smile deserves a custom design. Book your evaluation with our dental team and find out which treatment can get you the result you want.
